assessments.target: remaining → request arrow, Korean and English
assessments.reason: Both labels express that all buffers have completed, any remaining work is conditional, and the handler explicitly calls the function named by the destination node, completeRequest(). The source says the last buffer does not automatically complete the request, describes the opportunity for remaining operations, and requires an explicit call. The return value of completeBuffer() reports whether all buffers have completed; the request-return loop also asserts that a returned request has no pending buffers.

The source says completeRequest() may be called on any complete request without an ordering constraint, while requests are returned to the application in submission order. The existing application node and its incoming edge preserve that distinction.

limits: The assessment is limited to the supplied pinned source window and the ordinary completion edge. Cancellation and CameraManager-thread obligations are outside the requested label scope.
